analysis_summary: S2 LLD declares 12 new backend files and 4 modifications to S1 files. All 12 new files land in directories that already exist from S1's /ases-scaffold (backend/src/{infrastructure/db/models, infrastructure/db/repositories, domain, application/services, presentation/schemas, presentation/api/routers}, backend/db/migrations/versions). The 12 new files themselves are CREATED at /ases-dev time per CLAUDE rule 2 (only output_files[] from task plan written during /ases-dev). The scaffold step therefore identifies ONE genuine structural addition: the test directory backend/tests/unit/domain/ for test_stock.py (TC-079..TC-086), which does NOT exist yet in S1's test tree.

dependency_changes.rationale: S2 deps_manifest.packages = []. Every Python import in S2 LLD is from S1's installed dependency set (sqlalchemy 2.0.36, alembic 1.14.0, fastapi 0.115.6, pydantic 2.10.4, psycopg 3.2.3, testcontainers 4.9.0, pytest 8.3.4).
